hook: A California judge refused to freeze a $1.23 million legal demand.

sections.voiceover: A California judge refused to freeze a $1.23 million legal demand.
b_roll: Courtroom gavel striking wooden sound block during motion hearing

sections.voiceover: In November 2026, Los Angeles Superior Court denied Smokey Robinson a delay. Four former workers requested $1.23 million in legal fees. Will the court pause ruling before the 2027 trial?
b_roll: Exterior view of Los Angeles Superior Court courthouse building
Document icon highlighting legal fee request
Calendar graphic marking upcoming 2027 trial date

sections.voiceover: But on August 18, 2026, a Los Angeles Superior Court judge granted the Robinsons a temporary delay.
b_roll: Court ruling timeline graphic highlighting August 18, 2026 date

sections.voiceover: Six former employees now pursue claims in a $50 million lawsuit. Filings name both 86-year-old Smokey and 74-year-old Frances Gladney Robinson.
b_roll: Data visualization displaying $50 million lawsuit total
Motion hearing symbol indicating appeal proceedings
Graphics displaying Smokey Robinson age 86 and Frances Gladney Robinson age 74

sections.voiceover: Legal fees remain contested as the 2027 trial date approaches.
b_roll: Scales of justice symbol positioning next to 2027 trial date graphic
